# Innovation Vision Consulting Group (IVCG)

> Innovation Vision Consulting Group (IVCG), a trade name of IVC Blueprint LLC, is a Miami-based strategy, operations and financial advisory firm. IVCG works with founders, growing companies and organizations in transition, with signature expertise in sports (teams, clubs, supporter organizations, leagues) and live events and entertainment.

Services: business strategy, strategic growth planning, executive advisory, operations consulting, organizational analysis, process improvement, operational audits, risk identification, financial planning and modeling, investor readiness, transaction preparation, restructuring support, and implementation support. IVCG provides advisory services only.

Languages: English, French, Spanish, Portuguese.

Contact: contact@ivconsultinggroup.com, +1 786 548 1743
Office: 990 Biscayne Boulevard, Ste 501, Miami, FL 33132

## Résumé (français)

Innovation Vision Consulting Group (IVCG), nom commercial d'IVC Blueprint LLC, est un cabinet de conseil en stratégie, opérations et finance basé à Miami. IVCG accompagne fondateurs, entreprises en croissance et organisations en transition, avec une expertise de référence dans le sport (clubs, équipes, associations de supporters, ligues) et l'événementiel et le divertissement.
